title: What If Chocolate Ran Short? Cocoa Already Hit Record Prices

scenes.text: What if chocolate got too scarce to afford? Its price already broke a record.
Ivory Coast and Ghana grow around two-thirds of the world's cocoa beans.
In March 2024, cocoa topped ten thousand dollars a ton for the first time ever.
Heavy rain, dry heat and black pod disease cut harvests. Port arrivals fell 28 percent in Ivory Coast and 35 percent in Ghana.
A virus called swollen shoot hit 81 percent of Ghana's main cocoa region.
London cocoa reached about 11,500 dollars a tonne in June 2024, against 3,182 the year before. Chocolate won't vanish, but it gets pricey.
